title: 19-year-old fatally shot by police, believed to have stabbed family member in Mississauga on Thursday
subtitle: Officers "attempted to negotiate" with the man after the stabbing. The injured 39-year-old victim was found at a neighbour's residence where he had sought help, the province's police watchdog said Thursday night.
article: A 19-year-old man is dead after being shot by a police officer at a Mississauga home on Thursday.
The man was a suspect in a stabbing that sent one victim to hospital in the afternoon, Peel police said in a post on social media.
Officers responded to a call about an injured man at 2:30 p.m. on Greensboro Drive , the Special Investigations Unit, Ontario's police watchdog, said in a Thursday news release .

A 39-year-old man was found suffering from stab wounds in the residence and was taken to hospital, the SIU said. It was later determined he was stabbed by a family member in a residence nearby and was seeking help at a neighbour's home, SIU spokesperson Kristy Denette told reporters Thursday night.
Officers with police dogs attended the victim's home and "attempted to negotiate" with the man believed to have committed the stabbing.
Seven officers entered the home's basement, Denette said, where a taser was deployed and the man was shot.
Police said the man had an "edged weapon," but SIU investigators have not yet independently confirmed that account, she added.
The shot 19-year-old man was taken to hospital, where he died "a short time later," investigators added.
The initial incident was not a random stabbing and there is no threat to public safety, Denette said.
Investigators have not yet confirmed the relationship between the stabbing victim and the 19-year-old, other than that they are family members, she said.
The 39-year-old man is still in hospital, Denette added. A family member is at the hospital with him and was informed of the shooting, she said.
The officer who shot their gun was also taken to hospital, Denette said, adding she believed it was precautionary and that the officer was not physically injured.
The SIU is investigating the incident with three investigators and three forensic investigators assigned to the case. An autopsy on the fatally shot man is being scheduled.
Investigators will speak to the hospitalized man when he is able, the residents who were helping him and will examine body camera footage when it is available, Denette said.
